problem: Immutable claim files remain CLAIMED after owning runs reach DONE/RETURN, while allocator activeClaimedIds classifies CLAIMED as active from the claim record alone. At scale this conflates historical dedup ownership with live execution ownership and can distort active-worker, recovery and exhaustion derivation.
acceptance: Derive opportunity lifecycle from immutable claim plus run/recovery/return evidence into at least ACTIVE, COMPLETED, BOUNDARY, STALE_ELIGIBLE and HISTORICAL_CLAIM without rewriting the original claim.
Allocator/recovery/control projections use derived live ownership for activity while completed opportunities remain excluded from duplicate re-execution.
The completed kernel lineage with an original CLAIMED claim and a DONE run plus RETURN is classified COMPLETED, not active, without making the opportunity selectable again.
Tests cover late return, concurrent recovery race, stale claim without run, boundary without return and completed return; ambiguous evidence fails closed.
title: Derive terminal opportunity lifecycle
mission: Implement a deterministic lifecycle projection that joins immutable claim, run, recovery and return evidence so live worker ownership is not inferred from stale CLAIMED claim records, while preserving claim immutability and one-shot dedup semantics.

unblock_value.reason: Live allocation, recovery and Control Room projections need a truthful distinction between historical exclusive ownership and a worker that is still active.

information_gain.reason: A lifecycle join makes terminal, boundary and stale states machine-derivable from durable evidence instead of relying on the original claim state.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers can determine whether capacity is actually occupied without the human or a surviving chat explaining which claims already finished.

regression_prevention.reason: Fail-closed lifecycle tests can prevent false recovery, false active-worker counts and accidental re-execution while preserving append-only recovery semantics.

falsification: A claim whose owning run is DONE with a durable RETURN is still reported as live active ownership.
A completed opportunity becomes selectable again merely because it is no longer counted as active.
A stale recovery candidate is accepted despite a newer heartbeat, RETURN or live write collision.
Ambiguous or conflicting run/recovery evidence is silently collapsed to COMPLETED or ACTIVE instead of failing closed.
dedup_note: Current queues contain allocator, recovery, Control Room, metrics and stress-verifier work, but the inspected allocator still derives active ownership directly from immutable claim.state and the inspected proposal search did not surface a dedicated terminal opportunity-lifecycle join. This proposal is a narrow shared primitive rather than a replacement for those lanes.
